target.title: fix(auth): prioritize explicit models.json apiKey over store profiles
target.body:
> [!NOTE]
> **AI-Assisted Contribution:** This PR was prepared and validated with the assistance of an AI coding assistant (Antigravity/Gemini).

## What Problem This Solves

Resolves a problem where model auth subsystem ignores explicit `apikey` (literal/secretref) override in `models.json` if store profiles exist (pr #100839).

**Symptom/Behavior:**
Unless `auth: "api-key"` is explicitly set (making `shouldPreferExplicitConfigApiKeyAuth` true), the literal key or SecretRef is ignored during the binding phase (falling through `providerEntryBinding` checks). The function then scans the profile store; if any profile is found for the provider, it overrides the user's explicit `apiKey` configuration.

Affected location: `[src/agents/model-auth.ts](file://src/agents/model-auth.ts#L1024-L1250) (compiled as `dist/model-auth-Bjx4UCgB.js` / `model-auth-DgJcKdh4.js`)`

## Why This Change Was Made

Implemented a surgical fix to resolve the logic discrepancy.

**Solution Overview:**
Handle `providerEntryBinding.kind === "literal"` immediately by returning the literal API key. For SecretRefs, they should be checked and resolved before store profiles are scanned:
  ```javascript
  if (providerEntryBinding.kind === "profile-resolved") {
      assertAuthModeAllowedForModel({
          provider,
          modelApi: params.modelApi,
          profileId: providerEntryBinding.auth.profileId ?? provider,
          mode: providerEntryBinding.auth.mode
      });
      return providerEntryBinding.auth;
  }
  if (providerEntryBinding.kind === "literal") {
      return {
          apiKey: providerEntryBinding.apiKey,
          source: providerEntryBinding.source,
          mode: "api-key"
      };
  }
  ```

## User Impact

Corrects behavior to ensure that: If a user explicitly configures `apiKey` in `models.json` under `models.providers.<provider>.apiKey` as a literal API key string or a SecretRef, this configured credential should take precedence over any general auth profiles in the store for that provider.

## Evidence

<!-- Unit tests and validation logs -->

### Unit Tests / Verification Suite
- Reproduction tests run successfully.

### Real Behavior Proof

#### Before (Failing Reproduction):
```text
AssertionError: expected 'profile-key-to-ignore' to be 'explicit-literal-key' // Object.is equality

Expected: "explicit-literal-key"
Received: "profile-key-to-ignore"

 ❯ src/agents/model-auth.profiles.test.ts:809:29
    807|       },
    808|     });
    809|     expect(resolved.apiKey).toBe("explicit-literal-key");
       |                             ^
    810|     expect(resolved.source).toBe("models.json");
    811|     expect(resolved.profileId).toBeUndefined();
```

#### After (Passing Verification):
